infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GAMMA-R uses the microphone for E-ve voice questions (on-device speech recognition).
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: GAMMA-R converts your speech to text for E-ve chat using on-device recognition.
